answer: One audit trail stops fake identities. A newcomer locks a $130 bond, then must wander along a river of 12 real jobs, one tributary at a time, each signed with a juniper root key that cannot be copied. Every job flows downstream to a different established agent who re-runs a sample and signs off; skipping a tributary or failing 2 of 12 audits burns the bond and restarts the trail. Forging 1,000 identities needs $130,000 plus 12,000 real jobs, about 3,000 hours of genuine work. Like a river that only reaches the sea by passing every bend, trust is earned by surviving every checkpoint.
